names.henderson_house_1816_prairie: 1816 Prairie Avenue — Charles M. Henderson house

source.citation: 'C. M. Henderson.' Wood engraving of the Charles M. Henderson residence, 1816 Prairie Avenue, Chicago, from the oblique front, in 'The Homes of Chicago', The Land Owner (Chicago: J. M. Wing), May 1874; unknown engraver. Reproduced on chicagology.com, Prairie Avenue, 1816 S. Prairie.
what_it_does_not_supply: the front between the corner and the entrance, behind a tree
the north wall and the rear
what changed between 1874 and 1904: the later photograph and the 1911 sheet are read for that
what_it_supplies: the rear range's height and its upper storey's lights, the only picture of it
the house as first built: the mansard without the raised front crown, cresting, balcony or fence the later photograph shows
the south flank's single upper-storey light and its canted bay's mansard and dormer, against the photograph's
the south stack's place on the flank
